d: In the bustling city of Bengaluru, Ramesh Babu's journey from a humble barber to a successful entrepreneur is nothing short of remarkable. In 1994, through frugal living, he managed to scrape together enough savings to purchase a Maruti Van. This was just the beginning of what would become a thriving car rental enterprise by 2004 boasting seven vehicles. By 2014, his modest fleet had astonishingly expanded to 200 vehicles.
